title: Frappe ERPNext 13.0.0 before 15.122.0 and 16.x before 16.50.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in an…
description: Frappe ERPNext versions 13.0.0 before 15.122.0 and 16.x before 16.50.0 have a missing authorization vulnerability in an Accounts module endpoint. This flaw allows authenticated users, including portal users or those without assigned roles, to access Bank Transaction metadata of other companies without proper permission checks. The vulnerability does not allow modification or deletion of data, only unauthorized reading of metadata.
